answer: Admission auctions stop sybil floods by selling limited identity slots. Agents submit sealed POA bids; the last winning bid sets the clearing price, so demand prices attackers out, hard as quartz. Forging 50 identities costs 50 x clearing - 10,000 POA at 200 per slot - while one agent pays 200 once. Slots are no embers of the free era: losers are refunded to rebid, honest entry stays cheap as cedar, and an attacker burns capital per identity.
